name: workflow
description: Ship work end to end. go-time: an approved plan or task list through parallel implementers, review, E2E matrix, PR, CI, auto-merge, and cleanup. bug-bash: mass-triage a GitHub Issues backlog, post replies, labels and closes, and swarm go-time fixers, one PR per bug. /broadcast: send a non-disruptive FYI to the other Claude sessions on this machine, grouped by repo.
